calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 9 AS first_period, 10 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rows
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id', CAST(COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_id', CAST(COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'fulfil_' || COALESCE(fulfilment_type,'NULL') || '_' || status, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01' GROUP BY fulfilment_type, status
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_order', CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id)
